definitions.text_mt: Fdalijiet inkandexxenti ta' karbonju jew injam li jibqgħu jaħarqu wara n-nar mingħajr fjamma.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġamar kien għadu jaħraq fil-fuklar filgħodu.
usage_examples.text_en: The embers were still burning in the hearth in the morning.

usage_examples.text_mt: Xerred il-ġamar mal-art b'daqqa ta' siequ.
usage_examples.text_en: He scattered the embers on the ground with a kick of his foot.

definitions.text_mt: Ortografija alternattiva ta' 'ġema'. Ifisser li wieħed jiġbor affarijiet jew persuni flimkien.
Ortografija alternattiva ta' 'ġema'. Ifisser li wieħed jakkumula xi ħaġa maħ oġra.

usage_examples.text_mt: Huwa ġama’ l-flus kollha f'kont wieħed.
usage_examples.text_en: He collected all the money in one account.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġama’ il-kotba tiegħu qabel ma telaq mid-dar.
usage_examples.text_en: He gathered his books before leaving home.

definitions.text_en: jam (sweet mixture of fruit boiled with sugar)
definitions.text_mt: Marmalata magħmula minn frott imsajjar biz-zokkor, li tinfirex fuq il-ħobż.
Imblokk jew konġestjoni ta' traffiku fejn il-vetturi ma jistgħux jiċċaqilqu.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ferrexet il-ġamm fuq il-ħobż għall-kolazzjon.
usage_examples.text_en: She spread the jam on the bread for breakfast.

usage_examples.text_mt: Konna nsofru ġamm kbir fit-triq lejn il-belt dalgħodu.
usage_examples.text_en: We suffered a big traffic jam on the way to the city this morning.

definitions.text_en: Jamaica (an island and country in the Caribbean)
definitions.text_mt: Gżira u pajjiż fil-Karibew, magħrufa għall-bajjiet sbieħ, il-mużika reggae u l-kultura vibranti tagħha.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-Ġammajka hi magħrufa għall-mużika reggae u Bob Marley.
usage_examples.text_en: Jamaica is known for reggae music and Bob Marley.

usage_examples.text_mt: Żort il-Ġammajka s-sena l-oħra u għoġbitni l-kultura
usage_examples.text_en: I visited Jamaica last year and I liked the culture.

etymology_chain.definition: an acorn, nut; any acorn-shaped fruit; a beechnut, chestnut

definitions.text_mt: Frott tal-ballut, ta' għamla ovali, b'qoxra iebsa u tapit fil-bażi.
Frott li għadu ma misjurx, speċjalment frott żgħir u iebes.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġandar kien mifrux mal-art taħt is-siġra tal-ballut.
usage_examples.text_en: The acorns were scattered on the ground under the oak tree.

usage_examples.text_mt: Dan it-tuffieħ għadu ġandar u mhux tajjeb għall-ikel.
usage_examples.text_en: This apple is still unripe and not good to eat.

definitions.text_mt: Li jixbah il-ġandar fil-forma jew fid-dehra.
Li għadu mhux misjur, speċjalment frott.

usage_examples.text_mt: Dawn it-tuffieħ għandhom togħma ġandrija.
usage_examples.text_en: These apples have an unripe taste.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-bćula kienet għadha ġandrija u ma setgħetx tittiekel.
usage_examples.text_en: The watermelon was still unripe and could not be eaten.

definitions.text_mt: Pajjiż fil-Lvant tal-Asja, magħruf għat-teknoloġija avvanzata, il-kultura antika u l-arkitettura tradizzjonali tiegħu.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-Ġappun huwa magħruf għat-teknoloġija u l-kultura tradizzjonali tiegħu.
usage_examples.text_en: Japan is known for its technology and traditional culture.

usage_examples.text_mt: Dejjem xtaqt iżur il-Ġappun biex nara l-fjuri taċ-ċirasa.
usage_examples.text_en: I always wanted to visit Japan to see the cherry blossoms.

definitions.text_en: Japanese (of, from or relating to Japan)
definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Ġappun, man-nies tiegħu, mal-lingwa tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-kċina Ġappuniża hi popolari ħafna madwar id-dinja.
usage_examples.text_en: Japanese cuisine is very popular around the world.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġnien Ġappuniż fil-belt huwa paċifiku u sabiħ.
usage_examples.text_en: The Japanese garden in the city is peaceful and beautiful.

definitions.text_en: Japanese (native or inhabitant of Japan) (usually male)
definitions.text_mt: Persuna indiġena tal-Ġappun, ġeneralment raġel.
Il-lingwa uffiċjali tal-Ġappun.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-Ġappuniżi huma magħrufa għall-edukazzjoni u x-xogħol iebes tagħhom.
usage_examples.text_en: The Japanese are known for their education and hard work.

usage_examples.text_mt: Qed nitgħallem il-Ġappuniż biex inkun nista' naħdem fil-Ġappun.
usage_examples.text_en: I am learning Japanese so I can work in Japan.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tgħix ħdejn jew qrib id-dar ta' xi ħadd ieħor.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġar tagħna dejjem jgħinna meta jkollna bżonn.
usage_examples.text_en: Our neighbour always helps us when we need it.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġirien iltaqgħu flimkien għal barbecue fis-sajf.
usage_examples.text_en: The neighbours got together for a barbecue in the summer.

definitions.text_en: female equivalent of ġar: a female neighbour
definitions.text_mt: Mara li tgħix ħdejn jew qrib id-dar ta' xi ħadd ieħor.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġara tagħna hi mara sabiħa u ġeneruża.
usage_examples.text_en: Our female neighbour is a kind and generous woman.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġara l-ġdida ġiet tislmilna lbieraħ filgħaxija.
usage_examples.text_en: The new female neighbour came to greet us yesterday evening.

definitions.text_mt: Seħħ jew twettaq, speċjalment mingħajr ma kien ippjanat.
Sar f'post u żmien partikolari.

usage_examples.text_mt: X'ġara lbieraħ fil-laqgħa tal-kunsill?
usage_examples.text_en: What happened yesterday at the council meeting?

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġara xi ħaġa importanti li rrid ngħidlek.
usage_examples.text_en: Something important happened that I need to tell you.

definitions.text_mt: Marda tal-ġilda kkawżata minn dud żgħir li jidħol taħt il-ġilda, li tikkawża ħakk kbir.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġarab jinfirex malajr bejn il-persuni f'kuntatt mill-qrib.
usage_examples.text_en: Scabies spreads quickly between people in close contact.

usage_examples.text_mt: It-tabib iddijanjostika l-ġarab u tah kura speċjali.
usage_examples.text_en: The doctor diagnosed the scabies and gave him special treatment.

definitions.text_mt: Strument perkussiv magħmul mill-metall li jdoqq meta jintlaqat, ġeneralment b'forma ta' qanpiena.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġaras tal-knisja daqq filgħodu għall-quddiesa.
usage_examples.text_en: The church bell rang in the morning for mass.

usage_examples.text_mt: Smajt il-ħoss tal-ġaras mill-ġnien t'isfel.
usage_examples.text_en: I heard the sound of the bell from the garden below.

definitions.text_en: verbal noun of ġarr: transport, carriage
definitions.text_mt: Trasport ta' oġġetti jew persuni minn post għal ieħor.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġarr tal-għamara kien diffiċli minħabba t-taraġ dejjaq.
usage_examples.text_en: The transport of the furniture was difficult because of the narrow stairs.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-kumpanija tispeċjalizza fil-ġarr ta' merkanzija bejn Malta u Sqallija.
usage_examples.text_en: The company specialises in the carriage of goods between Malta and Sicily.

definitions.text_mt: Refaʻ xi ħaġa miegħu minn post għal ieħor.

usage_examples.text_mt: Huwa ġarr il-basktijiet tqal lejn il-karozza.
usage_examples.text_en: He carried the heavy bags towards the car.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ħaddiema ġarru l-oġġetti kollha mill-maħżen.
usage_examples.text_en: The workers carried all the items from the warehouse.

definitions.text_mt: Bastiment tal-ħġieġ, tal-fuħħar jew tal-plastik b'fetħa wiesgħa, użat biex iżomm ikel, xorb jew sustanzi oħra.

usage_examples.text_mt: Poġġiet l-ilma fil-ġarra tal-fuħħar biex jibqa' frisk.
usage_examples.text_en: She put the water in the clay jar to keep it cool.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ixtrajt ġarra taż-żejt taż-żebbuġa mis-suq Malti.
usage_examples.text_en: I bought a jar of olive oil from the Maltese market.

definitions.text_mt: Ipprova xi ħaġa biex jara jekk taħdimx jew jekk togħġobx.
Pprova affarijiet ġodda biex jara r-riżultat.

definitions.text_en: to put through trial, temptation, tribulation
definitions.text_mt: Għadda lil xi ħadd minn prova jew tbatija biex jittestja l-fidi jew is-saħħa tiegħu.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġarrab din l-ikla ġdida u għidli jekk togħbokx.
usage_examples.text_en: Try this new dish and tell me if you like it.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġarrab li titkellem magħha qabel ma tieħu deċizjoni.
usage_examples.text_en: Try talking to her before making a decision.

usage_examples.text_mt: Alla ġarrab lil Abraham biex jittestja l-fidi tiegħu.
usage_examples.text_en: God put Abraham through a trial to test his faith.

definitions.text_en: to demolish, to cause to collapse
definitions.text_mt: Waqqaʻ xi struttura, bini jew ħajt, ħafna drabi b'mod vjolenti.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-maltemp ġarraf id-dar antika tal-ġebla.
usage_examples.text_en: The storm demolished the old stone house.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-bulldozer ġarraf il-ħajt kollu fi ftit minuti biss.
usage_examples.text_en: The bulldozer demolished the entire wall in just a few minutes.

definitions.text_mt: Logħba fejn persuna tkun fuq dahar xi ħadd ieħor, ħafna drabi biċ-ċajt.

usage_examples.text_mt: It-tfal kienu jilagħbu l-ġarrażejt fil-bitħa tal-iskola.
usage_examples.text_en: The children were playing piggyback in the school yard.

usage_examples.text_mt: Agħtini ġarrażejt sa fejn il-ħanut ta' taħt.
usage_examples.text_en: Give me a piggyback ride down to the shop below.

definitions.text_mt: Ortografija alternattiva ta' 'ġeru'. Ifisser kelb żgħir.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġarun kien qed jilgħab mal-ballun fil-ġnien.
usage_examples.text_en: The puppy was playing with the ball in the garden.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-kelb tagħna welldet tliet ġeru sbieħ.
usage_examples.text_en: Our dog gave birth to three beautiful puppies.

definitions.text_en: jewellery, jewels or precious stones and ornaments
definitions.text_mt: Ħaġar prezzjuż, deheb u oġġetti oħra ta' valur użati bħala ornamenti.

definitions.text_en: anything precious, a jewel, treasure (e.g. historical, natural)
definitions.text_mt: Kwalunkwe ħaġa ta' valur kbir, prezzjuża jew għażiża.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġawhar tar-reġina kien jinsab fil-mużew nazzjonali.
usage_examples.text_en: The queen's jewels were kept in the national museum.

usage_examples.text_mt: Din il-pittura antika hi ġawhar nazzjonali ta' valur kbir.
usage_examples.text_en: This ancient painting is a national treasure of great value.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li m'għandhiex ħafna għaqlu jew li tagħmel affarijiet iblah.

usage_examples.text_mt: Tkun ġaħan jekk temmen kull ħaġa li jgħidulek.
usage_examples.text_en: You would be a fool if you believe everything they tell you.

usage_examples.text_mt: Dak il-ġaħan tilef il-flus kollha fil-logħob.
usage_examples.text_en: That fool lost all his money in gambling.

definitions.text_mt: Irnexxielu jagħmel xi ħaġa bi tbatija kbira, u bil-kemm.

definitions.text_en: to perform an action with difficulty
definitions.text_mt: Mexxa 'l quddiem bi tbatija f'xi attività.
Għadda minn sitwazzjoni diffiċli bi tbatija.
Mexxa bil-mod u b'diffikultà, speċjalment minħabba għeja jew mard.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġaħġaħ fl-iskola u rnexxielu jgħaddi mill-eżami bil-kemm.
usage_examples.text_en: He scraped through school and barely passed the exam.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-marid ġaħġaħ lejn il-bieb b'passi żgħar u battojja.
usage_examples.text_en: The patient shuffled towards the door with small, unsteady steps.

definitions.text_en: a baby cheese, especially a certain kind that is common in Maltese cuisine (in local English called a cheeselet)
definitions.text_mt: Ġobon żgħir f'forma ta' kejk, tipiku tal-kċina Maltija, magħmul minn ħalib tal-mogħoż jew tan-nagħaġ, imfarrad u mħalli jitferma.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġbejna Maltija hi magħmula minn ħalib tal-mogħoż u mħallta bit-tmelliħ.
usage_examples.text_en: The Maltese cheeselet is made from goat's milk and salted.

usage_examples.text_mt: Kilt ġbejna friska mal-ħobż u t-tadam għall-ponta fl-ikla ta' nofsinhar.
usage_examples.text_en: I ate a fresh cheeselet with bread and tomato for a snack at lunchtime.
